title: Episode 27
overview: A wealthy banker whose daughter has been kidnapped calls on Butt Detective. The criminal is demanding his famous Rainbow Diamond, but it's missing.

title: Episode 28
overview: Butt Detective's search for the Rainbow Diamond is almost at an end. But some wall-writings indicate that actually picking it up might not be so easy.

title: Episode 29
overview: Kaito U's back and he's threatening to steal a porcine spa's "greatest treasure." Butt Detective and the K-9s try to deduce what it could be.

title: Episode 30
overview: Butt Detective and Brown head to a local festival, where a troublemaker who looks just like the double-cheeked detective has been making mischief.

title: Episode 31
overview: Butt Detective uses the cards and coin that his doppelganger left behind to locate him. Meanwhile, Brown helps his new female friend find her ribbon.

title: Episode 32
overview: A new investigator claims to be the best and challenges Butt Detective to a public detective match. But our hero senses something amiss.

title: Episode 33
overview: There's trouble at the KNK bank and the police ask Butt Detective to take the job. But soon Carrot Horse butts in, complicating the situation.

title: Episode 34
overview: Butt Detective receives another request from rich banker Kamenokoji. His daughter Midori is up to something odd and he wants the sleuth to tail her.

title: Episode 35
overview: The K-9 cops and a gang of sparrow laborers ask Butt Detective to look into what's behind a series of spooky ghost-sightings at an old clock tower.

title: Episode 36
overview: After feline thieves nab a special cane, Butt Detective is on the case. He's joined by his double-cheeked dad, who has a history with the stolen item.

title: Episode 37
overview: Brown and his koala pal star in a new detective movie. But behind the scenes, Butt Detective must solve a real case involving some thieving monkeys.

title: Episode 38
overview: Butt Detective arrives at Castle Wolf to protect its booty from Kaito U. But he gets the impression there's something not quite right with his host.

title: Episode 39
overview: Butt Detective arrives at the treasure only to see it stolen by Kaito U. But then a second Kaito U appears and each claims that the other is a phony.
